summary: Julong Holding Ltd filed a 6-K on June 16, 2026, reporting the resignation of Director and Audit Committee member Jinying Wang, effective June 9, 2026, and the simultaneous appointment of Shengshan Sun as an independent director and member of Audit, Compensation, and Nominating/Governance committees. The resignation was not due to any disagreement. Sun's background includes academic and law association roles. The Board now has five members with revised committee compositions. This is a routine board change with no controversy, but given it is a departure and appointment, it qualifies as a management change. No deal terms are applicable.
